You are the person who listens in conversation with specialist areas, recognizes patterns and develops concrete use cases for AI, machine learning and business intelligence. Galliker is one of the leading Swiss logistics and transport companies with national and international locations. From the Altishofen site, an approximately 80-strong IT team manages over 20 branches throughout Europe and ensures smooth workflows in everyday work thanks to the latest technology, idea culture and strong teamwork. As a computer team, we strive every day to provide our internal and external customers with a state-of-the-art, efficient and high-performance infrastructure. For you, data is more than numbers. You want to understand how a company works, which questions concern the departments and how data generates concrete insights and recommendations for action. You master both the language of the departments and the language of the technical teams and can formulate requirements precisely and comprehensibly. In our Data Analytics team, you work at the interface between departments and data engineering.
